_description: Estimated 24h pilot claim for cascade-compression deployed on infra01 (2026-09-03), observing RHPDS-wide signals. Cascade runs on infra01 but ingests signals from across the RHPDS fleet — the 1000-signal population represents platform-wide volume, not a single cluster. UPDATED for SC hybrid gatekeeper: semantic classifier now handles ~60% of signals at ~1ms (CPU-only, ~$0 cost) instead of LLM at ~4.6s. Signal normalization reduces cache misses by 40%, yielding ~2.2x throughput. Zero buffer drops (was 3.3M+ pre-hybrid). Numbers are guestimates from observed pilot and soak data — not customer-validated.

_data_sources.replay: tests/fixtures/value_evidence/replay.json (1000 signals, matched workload across RHPDS)

baseline_route_ledger._note: Pre-hybrid: all AI-eligible signals went to LLM (4.6s p50, 3.3M+ buffer drops at scale)

cascade_route_ledger._note: Post-hybrid: SC handles ~60% at 1ms/~$0, LLM fallback for ambiguous/unsafe. Zero buffer drops. ai_calls now 140 (130 cascade + 10 severity-gated forced to LLM).

routes._note: SC confident (margin >= hybrid_suppress_margin 0.20). CPU-only, no GPU/API cost.
High/critical signals where SC wanted to suppress — forced to LLM for safety.

value_dimensions._notes: Baseline inference $60.00 (600 LLM calls). With SC hybrid: 360 signals classified by SC at $0 (CPU-only, 1.4ms p50), 120 remaining LLM calls at $14.00. Net savings $46.00/day. SC eliminates 60% of LLM calls entirely. Additional throughput value: signal normalization reduces cache misses 40% (2.2x throughput), zero buffer drops vs 3.3M+ pre-hybrid.

Phase-1 soak used 30 pods on Xeon 6767P ($30k, 1200W). 78% compression means ~23 fewer pods needed at scale. Prorated to 24h pilot: 0.017 unit-days. This is a projection, not observed savings on actual hardware allocation.

470 signals handled by nano agents + SC. Post-hybrid: all signals now classified (zero buffer drops — was 3.3M+ pre-hybrid), so this count represents complete coverage, not a sample. human_touch_rate 0.20 accounts for existing automation (PagerDuty grouping, silence rules, on-call fatigue/ignoring) — only ~20% of these would have actually consumed an engineer's attention. Investigation reduced to 8 min from 15 min default because infra01 K8s events have structured context, most are glance-and-dismiss. Rate $95/hr for RHDP platform SRE with benefits. False suppression rate ~8% is tracked as a quality risk.

1 real_incident in ground truth (pool_exhausted). Baseline MTTR 45 min from RHDP ops. Improved MTTR 15 min assumes cascade surfaces it sooner. Cost $5/min = $300/hr — 2 engineers at $95/hr loaded + modest coordination overhead. Conservative; does not include opportunity cost or downstream user impact. Single incident in 24h is too small a sample for statistical confidence.

5 provision_failed signals in ground truth but not all would generate tickets — most are auto-retried. Conservatively 2 tickets from the failures that actually blocked a user. 1 hour total productivity preserved (2 users × 30 min wait). No actual ticket data from pilot.

The 72h pre-hardening run (10,964 memories, 462 causal links) had a bug that was fixed — those numbers are not usable. No post-hardening memory production data exists yet for this pilot. Decision acceleration halved to 10/day as a placeholder until recall-to-decision tracking is instrumented. Knowledge retention factor reduced to 0.30 (from 0.40) since we cannot verify what the post-fix memory system actually captures. memories_formed and causal_links_discovered omitted — no valid post-fix counts. This entire dimension is unverified and should be replaced with observed data from a post-hardening memory production run.

Cascade handles 94 effective signals/day that would have consumed ~17h of triage work. That's roughly 2 FTE of shift work, but cascade doesn't eliminate the on-call role — it removes the worst part (noise triage). 0.5 FTE represents partial displacement across a 6-person RHPDS platform team (8.3% displacement ratio). Reskilling pathway: 0.3 FTE redirected to incident analysis, 0.2 FTE to cascade rule authoring — both higher-value work that leverages existing domain knowledge.

engineering_effort._notes: 43 signals manually reviewed and labeled for classifier calibration

evidence._sc_evidence_note: 90.8% SC↔LLM agreement over 1,872 comparison records. ~8% false suppression rate (SC suppress where LLM would escalate). Severity gate catches high/critical false suppressions. Minority-class stats weak (real_incident n≈2) — need 5-10x more soak for ±5pp per-label precision.
